held_policy: Open once only after router source commit, all formal selected-model identities, and end-to-end execution source are sealed. No held-driven retuning.
router_selection: 416 training examples, 102 selection examples; all 24 frozen candidate configurations per seed retained; 3 exploratory development rounds charged separately.
router_seed_interpretation: Deterministic lbfgs replication checks, not five independent language samples or stochastic optimizations.

memory_fit.catalog: explicit values and programs, fully charged

time_contract.semantic_and_procedure: current stable values at the admitted source cut

network_scope: Independent loopback processes and copied immutable source/model bundles; one publication authority; final per-participant revalidation. Not a WAN consensus protocol.
cost_scope: All retained sources, catalogs, models, candidates, development, replay and metadata; measured CPU/wall time and HTTP body bytes. Work proxy is not hardware FLOPs. No energy/currency claim.
structure_gate: Adaptive selection must beat the strongest eligible fixed K comparator after all search costs and declared amortization; otherwise report no superiority.
transfer_scope: New nonce entities and domains after writes, plus separately audited structured compositions using registered types and primitives; no claim of unseen natural-language intents or invented primitives.
deployment_status: Qualification implementation and native owner bridge; no live production activation.
